hypothesis: Verify that complete frozen profile-evidence pilots reproduce their native outputs, scores and original gates. Describe family-level uncertainty without treating development-exposed point gains as independent confirmation.
control: The declared off arm must exactly reproduce the retained canonical candidate partition, membership constraints, native products, rooted species tree and OrthoBench precision/recall/F1.
readback: Require successful terminal scheduler accounting on16 CPUs/128G/bizon, all declared arms in original order, immutable launch/plan/source/runtime/input checks, actual activation, raw command/log/resource agreement, full ownership and native product consistency, and repeated official plus independent OrthoBench scoring with per-family records. Shared validated helper implementations do not constitute an independent scoring implementation or biological confirmation panel.

uncertainty.pairing: Resample the same RefOG multiplicities for every arm and recompute the original weighted statistic from TP/FP/FN sufficient statistics. Repeat exactly to verify determinism.
uncertainty.limitations: Post hoc after observing development point results. Exchangeable-family resampling can miss shared evolutionary histories or dependencies induced by fused predictions; percentile intervals and Bonferroni tail adjustments are descriptive approximations. They do not repair earlier method selection or substitute for independent confirmation.

advancement: Recompute the unchanged original point gate separately for every active arm: F1 strictly increases and neither precision nor recall declines by more than0.005. Bootstrap intervals never create a new gate, suppress a prespecified advancing arm or rescue a failed arm. All advancing arms require unchanged complete corrected-QfO/Three Kingdoms follow-up.
stopping_rule: Any incomplete producer, changed artifact/runtime, missing activation, native/scoring mismatch or inconsistent family statistics fails readback explicitly. Preserve the attempt; do not silently admit only selected passing rows or restart in the same namespace.
comparison_table: Include all eight named endpoints, explicit NA for unrun new arms and separately labeled retained comparator vectors from the immutable prior admission snapshot. Retained vectors are not freshly re-audited in this readback; functional means are not F1 and population differences remain limitations.

resources.timing: Source pilot timings are shared-host cached downstream replay, not isolated fresh full-pipeline inference; GNU-time RSS is maximum process, not aggregate process-tree memory.
